svg.aria-label: Level 04, Crown of Khosrow (2024 - 2025): Historical real-time strategy for iOS and Android. Quest: Build an empire across a living world map, on a phone. Build: One scene bootstrap that starts the grid, game state, timer and fog of war in every level. Boss fight: Moving armies smoothly on mobile: grid pathfinding built on Unity ECS, map areas loaded on demand. Tech: Unity, C#, Android, iOS.
